Sophia of Montferrat.fact: The marriage was recorded by both Doukas and George Sphrantzes in their respective chronicles.

Sophia of Montferrat.question: Sphrantzes records _____ as its location
Sophia of Montferrat.fact: Sphrantzes records Hagia Sophia as its location.

Sophia of Montferrat.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Sophia of Montferrat.question: John VIII, not content in his marriage, made every effort to avoid her, and as a result, Sophia spent much of her time in _____ isolated from her husband
Sophia of Montferrat.fact: John VIII, not content in his marriage, made every effort to avoid her, and as a result, Sophia spent much of her time in Constantinople isolated from her husband. However, Sphrantzes records that in August 1426 Sophia "fled the City [Constantinople] and returned to her homeland", and that a little more than a year later John VIII made Maria of Trebizond his wife.
